notes: binding of Gab1 is dependent on Grb2; Double mutant Y1349F/Y1356F inhibits both metastasis and transformation.  N1358H  is also critical for malignant transformation as it affects Grb2 binding and activation of the Ras pathway (mutantGRB-). H1352N which makes an high affinity GRB2 was highly transforming, but not metastatic (mutant 2X Grb2). Expression of the recombinant oncogene TPR-SEA, was comaparable to 2X GRB2 mutant phenotype.      A GRB2/2X GRB2 mutant was rescued by complementation in trans and resumed the ability to invade an in vitro reconstituted basement membrane.   ; promotes cell transformation in Tpr-Met expressing cells
